   "scheduleType": "Lecture",
   "credits": 3,
   "nuPath": [],
   "description": "Presents a comprehensive overview of health and safety issues as they relate to the environment and the workplace. Introduces students to the scientific and technical foundations of the subject including environmental pollutants and biological, chemical, and physical agents.    "description": "Offers a look at real-world challenges faced in supply chain management. Explores gathering market data on an industry and creating a should cost model.
